switch.electrical_connection: SPST rocker in battery positive upstream of Feather battery JST; Feather BAT feeds anchor BAT positive; negative/GND continuous
switch.contacts_closed: ON; battery connected to both boards and Feather charger
switch.contacts_open: Battery OFF; cell disconnected from charging; USB can still energize circuit

power.battery_connection: Battery positive through rocker to camera Feather JST positive; Feather BAT/GND directly to anchor BAT pigtail; battery negative continuous
power.charge_input: Camera Feather USB-C only; rocker ON to connect cell; net charging and termination with anchor load unverified
power.anchor_usb: Disconnected in assembled system; unplug anchor BAT pigtail and UART for independent USB servicing
power.usb_present_switch_off: Cell disconnected; Feather can run from USB and charger BAT output remains connected to anchor; not a validated batteryless operating mode
power.unloaded_charge_check: Disconnect anchor BAT pigtail and UART with USB/cell unplugged, then reconnect cell, rocker ON, charge via Feather USB
